companyFieldUpdates.description: PurposeEnergy develops, owns and operates organics-to-energy infrastructure that converts food and beverage residuals and wastewater into biogas, renewable electricity, renewable natural gas, clean water and related by-products. Quinbrook announced its acquisition of the platform on April 12, 2023 through its Net Zero Power Fund strategy; a separate legal closing date, exact stake and holding vehicle were not publicly disclosed. PurposeEnergy's project portfolio includes Middlebury Resource Recovery Center in Vermont, which reached commercial operation on October 21, 2024; the Minster, Ohio industrial-biogas facility, which began taking waste on July 16, 2026 and remained in ramp-up; the operating South Burlington, Vermont brewery-waste digester historically associated with Magic Hat and now Zero Gravity; and the St. Albans, Vermont resource-recovery center, which began exporting electricity in December 2024 and held its grand opening on May 29, 2025. These facility and SPV names are project identities beneath PurposeEnergy and are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later PurposeEnergy equity transfer or signed pending sale was identified through September 1, 2026.

set.event: PurposeEnergy held the grand opening for its St. Albans, Vermont resource-recovery facility after commercial operations began in December 2024.

milestoneTransfers.event: PurposeEnergy announced construction of an approximately US$18 million St. Albans, Vermont biogas facility serving Ben & Jerry's.
